why: status is the bar widget's poll: it answers the player row alone, and with nothing playing it answers nothing — and never touches the network
a state file with no live mpv behind it is swept, not drawn — a stale file must not invent a player
a bare ctl is a control call with nothing to control — the script answers nothing, and so does the port
an empty box opens on the stations everybody votes for — the answer was never meant to be nothing
a name searches radio-browser: the answer is station rows, each with the stream wired behind Play — a BBC row carries country, art and homepage
